key_decisions.decision: Retains repeated declaration and the layered descriptions without turning last words into an exact deathbed chronology.
Preserves parallel divine titles and the ruler’s justice and fear of God.
Unfolds the compressed light-rain-growth image with its implied comparison.
Reads the two negative clauses as rhetorical questions while noting the alternative declarative reading.
Preserves protective implements and the difficult final place expression without importing a named location.
Retains the difficult pinned names and eight hundred rather than replacing them from the parallel list.
Follows read Dodo and warriors, retains both son relationships, and continues into Eleazar’s stand.
Retains lentils and the uncertain gathering expression as a troop, not an invented place name.
Follows read three rather than written thirty and preserves both locations.
Unfolds the elliptical blood question without turning the water into literal blood.
Follows read Three and retains the number and group designation despite its difficulty with the next verse.
Preserves the unresolved repeated group name rather than silently substituting Thirty.
Follows read valiant and lion; retains the uncertain ariels term with explanation in Vocabulary.
Follows read man of appearance and preserves the reversal of weapons.
Preserves the explicit Thirty/Three distinction and the likely guard office.
Preserves Heleb and the fuller location of Ittai.
Retains the pinned compound name and origin forms.
Keeps the source’s differing Hararite and Ararite forms.
Follows read Hezrai and keeps Paarai.
Follows read singular bearer and preserves the foreign origin and service role.
Preserves the final Uriah name and stated total without forcing the preceding uncertain list to fit it.
